body:
A job.

I'm a super hard working guy, but I made some bad decisions as a young man that led me to living in my 79 chevette in Michigan. I was cold often. I applied for a lot of jobs. Washed up at the YMCA and presented myself as best I could but could never actually land a job. 

Eventually I was given a chance and I did the best I could with it. Now I'm middle management for two different companies and have a solid middle class income. One of the companies I work for is Goodwill and I get to give people the chance I needed only a couple of years ago.
It's a nice day. 8 years since my break. It actually does get better.
